name: npmrc registry credential settings
description: Registry-scoped credential settings in an npm configuration (.npmrc) file: _authToken, _auth and _password, with username, email and file-path settings beside them, and ${VARIABLE} references that replace a literal.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. A structured ini file, not a fixed-format token. The format of an npm token held in _authToken belongs to the existing npm token families; this family records only the file-level distinction between a literal, an environment reference and a file path.
